epic.title: Assessment & Examination Module
epic.body: Provides teachers with a comprehensive system to manage the complete examination lifecycle, including exam scheduling, subject-wise grading, student result management, and automated performance tracking.

features.title: Exam Configuration & Scheduling
features.body: Allows teachers to define exam titles, descriptions, targeted classes, and detailed subject schedules with time durations and max marks.

stories.title: Exam Configuration & List View
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to create, view, update, and delete exam schedules so I can plan assessments for my classes.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display cards for all scheduled exams (e.g., Mid-Term 2026, Unit Test 1).
Create: Modal form to add exam title, description, and select targeted classes (e.g., 7A, 7B).
Update: Ability to edit existing exam details and their subject-wise schedules.
Delete: Option to remove an exam record with a confirmation prompt.
Schedule Details: Each exam must support a nested schedule including Subject, Date, Max Marks, and Duration.

stories.title: Exam Persistence & Scheduling API
stories.body: API endpoints to manage exam metadata and nested subject-wise schedule rows.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/PUT: Save and update exam objects with class mappings and schedule arrays.
GET: Retrieve all exams filtered by the requesting teacher's associated classes.
DELETE: Remove exam records and cleanup associated schedule dependencies.

features.title: Grading & Marks Management
features.body: Dedicated workflow for teachers to select a subject within an exam and record student-wise marks.

stories.title: Student Marks Entry Interface
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to select a subject and enter marks for all students in a class list.
acceptanceCriteria: Subject Selector: List subjects within an exam to initiate grading.
Student List: Automatically load student names and roll numbers for the selected class/subject.
Input: Field to enter marks for each student with validation against 'Max Marks'.
Summary: Display total students and pending entries count.

stories.title: Marks & Results API
stories.body: API to store individual student performance records for specific assessments.
acceptanceCriteria: POST: Bulk upload or individual submission of student marks for an exam-subject pair.
Calculation: Auto-calculate percentage and determine grades (e.g., A, A+, B) based on marks entered.
GET: Retrieve historical marks for a specific student to populate their academic profile.
